uses: openEyeDropper's onSelect: with no selection it writes currentItemBackgroundColor for the `i` (background) eyedropper.
uses: How tests import THEME and use `const { h } = window;`.
uses: How tests import API and pass `initialData={{ elements: [API.createElement(...)] }}`.

acceptance: dark theme: stores the palette colour an element was drawn with, not its on-screen colour: given theme={THEME.DARK}; pickPixel(applyDarkModeFilter(COLOR_PALETTE.red[4])), expect h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor toBe COLOR_PALETTE.red[4] ("#e03131")

dark theme: stores an off-palette element colour from the scene, not its numeric inverse: given theme={THEME.DARK} and initialData={{ elements: [API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", backgroundColor: "#ff00ff", fillStyle: "solid" })] }}; pickPixel(applyDarkModeFilter("#ff00ff")), expect h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor toBe "#ff00ff" (without scene candidates the inverse gives about #d832d8)

dark theme: stores the canvas background colour from the scene, not its on-screen colour: given theme={THEME.DARK} and initialData={{ appState: { viewBackgroundColor: "#00ffff" } }}; pickPixel(applyDarkModeFilter("#00ffff")), expect h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor toBe "#00ffff" (the numeric inverse alone misses by up to 72 per channel)

light theme: stores the raw pixel unchanged: given theme={THEME.LIGHT}; pickPixel(applyDarkModeFilter(COLOR_PALETTE.red[4])), expect h.state.currentItemBackgroundColor toBe applyDarkModeFilter(COLOR_PALETTE.red[4])

acceptance: round-trips every default palette colour: given each opaque palette colour X (rule 3), expect revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(X)) toBe X
round-trips every default canvas background pick: given each X of DEFAULT_CANVAS_BACKGROUND_PICKS, expect revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(X)) toBe X
returns an exact caller candidate: given revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter("#123456"), ["#123456"]), expect toBe "#123456"
ignores the pixel's alpha and letter case: given revertDarkModeFilter("#D3D3D3FF"), expect toBe COLOR_PALETTE.black ("#1e1e1e")
never matches a transparent candidate: given revertDarkModeFilter("#ededed", ["transparent"]), expect toBe "#000000"

numerically inverts a mid-tone pixel that matches no candidate (%s): given X each of "#123456", "#abcdef", "#7a6b5c"; result = revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(X)), expect result toMatch /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/; each channel of result is within 2 of X's; each channel of applyDarkModeFilter(result) is within 2 of the pixel's (AC-4)
returns an invalid colour unchanged: given revertDarkModeFilter("not-a-color"), expect toBe "not-a-color"
